'''2009 Bespin Regionals Tom Frafjord DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Tom Fafjord
* '''Deck name:''' So Be It.... Jedi
* '''Username:''' CitizenSwanky
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
